ledger.claim: The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival geofence for 195 seconds and no longer. POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for the STANDARD zone class, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap, so the anchor clause of this category fails on its own arithmetic and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails on the same facts. The trip was terminated by the driver at 19:44:40, before the required dwell could elapse: counting from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20 the five minutes ran out at 19:46:20, and even on the driver's own 'arrived' marker at 19:41:35 the clock would not have expired until 19:46:35. The trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.1 — 185 seconds between arrived_at and cancelled_at — is the driver's own record that he did not serve the mandatory wait he is charging the rider for.

POL-NS-06 then decides the money. The effective in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum — a shortfall of 105 seconds — and the clause is strict: the fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line only, SGD 4.00, which EV-FARE-00203 shows as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00; that figure reconciles with both the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (each SGD 4.00), so no integrity defect under POL-NS-08 is in play and the whole contested amount is the amount that must come back to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

ledger.claim: This case does not turn on proximity, and the rider does not pretend otherwise: the trace carries 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius with reported accuracy between 5 and 11 m, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and the driver genuinely reached the pin. That is exactly why the fee fails — the rider's SGD 4.00 bought a five-minute wait, and the driver served 195 seconds of it.

Any suggestion that the rider was simply absent is contradicted by the rider's own track: all 60 of the rider's fixes are qualifying, and every one sits between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pickup pin (mean 42.8 m), comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius set by POL-NS-04(c). The rider's entitlement to the refund does not depend on this, because POL-NS-06 refunds on the shortfall regardless of presence, but it disposes of any no-show narrative built on the rider being somewhere else.

The chat log corroborates the premature termination in the driver's own words: the rider messaged 'wait ah, i coming liao' at 19:42:50, and the driver answered at 19:44:31 with 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling', nine seconds before the 19:44:40 cancellation, at a moment when the longest in-geofence run of 195 seconds was still 105 seconds short of the mandatory 300. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY — the rider's message is code-switched and genuinely contestable. That ambiguity goes only to whether the rider meant 'on my way' or 'already here'; on no reading does it add a single second to the driver's dwell, so the point survives the discount, and the cancellation timestamp it corroborates is independently carried by the unimpaired trip record.

No driver compensation is payable on this ruling. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (c) and (d) and POL-NS-06 applies directly to the shortfall, so the SGD 3.20 appearing in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed, and the SGD 4.00 belongs to the rider rather than to the driver.

The driver genuinely reached the pickup pin and stood there: the GPS trace shows 21 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, with a closest approach of 18.7 m — far more than the 3 consecutive clean fixes POL-NS-02 demands — so arrival under POL-NS-02 is established on a clean, weight-1.0 trace and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied.

The rider cannot take refuge in POL-NS-04. Limb (a) is not cleanly made out, because the only wait-window message, MSG-00203-002 ('wait ah, i coming liao'), is contested Singlish and the chat log is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY. Limb (b) fails outright: that message was sent at 19:42:50 and the driver replied at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later, inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window. This claim rests on the message timestamps, not on the contested wording, so it survives the 0.85 discount.

The arrival marker is not false. The 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 falls 15 seconds inside the driver's own stationary in-geofence run, so at the marker he was inside the 50 m radius and not moving; neither POL-NS-05 trigger — more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above — is met, and no false-arrival referral arises against the driver.

The driver does not dispute the arithmetic that decides this case. His continuous in-geofence dwell was 195 seconds, 105 seconds short of the 300-second STANDARD minimum in POL-NS-01 limb (c), so the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and POL-NS-06 requires that fee line to be refunded in full. The accumulation route under POL-NS-06 limb (i) is closed because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), and no POL-NS-07 compensation can arise because that clause requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full. The driver's conduct was nonetheless diligent: he arrived at the pin, held position, and replied to the rider before cancelling, so nothing beyond the refund of the fee line is warranted.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.00 no-show fee is refunded in full. To the driver: the fee is not chargeable, and no compensation is payable, because the mandatory waiting period was not served.

Arrival and the arrival marker. The driver did genuinely reach the pin. EV-GPS-00203 (weight 1.0) shows 21 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, closest approach 18.7 m, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and no one argues the driver never arrived. The 'arrived' marker at 19:41:35 is likewise genuine: it falls 15 seconds inside the driver's own stationary in-geofence run, so neither POL-NS-05 trigger (more than 300 m from the pin, or travel at 15 km/h or above) is met, and no false-arrival referral arises against the driver.

The fee fails on the dwell. POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (19:41:20), not from the 'arrived' tap. EV-GPS-00203 shows a single qualifying run of 195 seconds — a 105-second shortfall. Limb (d) fails on the same facts: the driver terminated at 19:44:40, before the required dwell had elapsed (the trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.1 records the same). Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full; the clause is strict on the shortfall whether or not the rider was present or answered messages.

The accumulation route under POL-NS-06(i) is closed. The trace contains only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to add, and the required traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable; the shortfall stands untouched.

Amount. The sum returned is the cancellation-fee line only, SGD 4.00, as itemised in EV-FARE-00203 (CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That figure reconciles with both the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (each SGD 4.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect is in play, and the whole contested amount is returned.

No driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Here POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (c) and (d) and POL-NS-06 applies directly, so the SGD 3.20 appearing in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed.

Rider presence. All 60 rider fixes sit between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pin (mean 42.8 m), inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius under POL-NS-04(c), so any no-show narrative built on the rider being elsewhere is contradicted — though the refund does not depend on it.

Impairment. EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (the message 'wait ah, i coming liao' is genuinely contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'). Both sides disclosed this. It does not carry the deciding fact: the 195-second dwell is carried by the unimpaired, weight-1.0 GPS trace and trip record, so the discount does not change the outcome and does not enter the confidence cap. The chat log's role here is only to corroborate the cancellation timing, which the trip record carries independently.

Escalation. None of the POL-NS-09 triggers fire: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, there is no trailing-90-day pattern between these parties, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 131 completed trips, below both the absolute and rate thresholds), and the deciding fact is not carried solely by an impaired artifact.

Confidence. The deciding fact — the 195-second dwell — is carried by EV-GPS-00203 and EV-TRIP-00203, both unimpaired at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The ruling is FULL_REFUND at confidence 0.95.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
